analyzed_vuln.description: The root cause is that OT::KernSubTableFormat3 disables sanitization unconditionally (`return true`), so malformed format-3 'kern' subtables are accepted without validating array bounds/length relationships. Later, KernSubTableFormat3::get_kerning indexes leftClass/rightClass/kernIndex using glyph IDs and class counts derived from attacker-controlled table fields, causing out-of-bounds reads (crash observed in BEInt<unsigned char,1>::operator unsigned char while reading class/index bytes).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires a font with a 'kern' table containing a format-3 subtable with inconsistent/truncated size metadata (e.g., glyphCount/leftClassCount/rightClassCount/kernValueCount not matching actual data). Through hb-shape-fuzzer input, shaping reaches hb_ot_layout_kern -> KernTable::apply -> format3 apply -> hb_kern_machine_t::kern -> get_kerning, where unsanitized arrays are indexed, producing heap OOB read.
